fields.description: When on, the values below replace the Website and Navbar settings.
fields.label: Apply Branding

fields.options:
These write straight into Website Settings and Navbar Settings — the fields Frappe itself reads. Nothing here overrides a template.
A field left blank is never pushed, so it will not wipe a value someone set by hand upstream. Clear a value at its source instead.
